Chapter 598: Chapter 30: Endless Realizations, Never Fully Understood (Subscribe Please)

“Longshan Patriarch, we are willing to submit.”

“Yes, we are willing to offer our Divine Lattice, as long as the Longshan Patriarch spares our lives and commands us at will hereafter.”

“We also ask the Longshan Patriarch for mercy.”

Witnessing True Gods and even Prime Gods falling one after another, the surviving gods were instantly chilled to the bone and began to beg for mercy.

Even the divine spirits who had lived through long ages trembled with fear in the face of life and death.

Compared to death, offering up their Divine Lattice seemed like an acceptable sacrifice, especially since Lin Yuan’s displayed power had clearly surpassed the Prime God, reaching the level of a Supreme God.

...

To plead with a Supreme God was not a shameful thing.

“Willing to submit?”

Lin Yuan’s expression was calm, unmoved.

If Lin Yuan had entered the Ocean of Light intending to negotiate with the gods, and they had agreed to his demands, offering their Divine Lattice voluntarily…

Lin Yuan really wouldn’t have exterminated them all.

But now?

Having already taken action, Lin Yuan had killed so many True Gods and Prime Gods, it seemed somewhat redundant to accept the gods’ submission at this point.

After all, Lin Yuan’s time in this world was only one thousand one hundred and ten years; these gods submitting now would surely be reluctant and unwilling.

Once Lin Yuan ended his journey and returned to the Main World, what actions these gods might take once they lost the deterrence of Lin Yuan was unpredictable.

Therefore—

With the intention of eradicating them from the roots, since Lin Yuan had chosen to take action, there was no need to leave any leeway.

Voluntarily offering the Divine Lattice?

Even if they didn’t offer it, Lin Yuan could take it himself.

And he could also gain a Divine Kingdom containing vast energies, useful for enhancing the Origin Fine Gold.

How to choose was clear to Lin Yuan.

Boom boom boom.

Accompanied by terrifying energy vibrations, the Spatial Layers shook intensely.

Within the Ocean of Light, all True Gods had completely perished, unable to withstand such overwhelming power, no matter how ancient.

Only eight Prime Gods survived.

Even so, these eight Prime Gods had paid a heavy price, their energies severely depleted.

From the moment Lin Yuan had started to act until now, it had been less than ten breaths’ time.

“Open!”

The Prime God of Light burned his divine power, finally unlocking the Spatial Layers’ seal of the Ocean of Light.

“Run.”

“Hurry and run.”

The remaining eight Prime Gods, not daring to hesitate, occupied deeper Spatial Layers and quickly distanced themselves from the Ocean of Light.

Lin Yuan stood in place, his gaze deep.

The Prime Gods were the ‘darlings’ of this world, and the True Divine Nature embodied some of the ‘authority’ of this world.

The Prime Gods mustered their strength to flee, and even if Lin Yuan opened a hundred and twenty million layers of space, it would be difficult to stop them in a short time.

After all, essentially, Lin Yuan and the ninth rank Prime Gods still existed at the same Life Level, albeit Lin Yuan’s foundation was slightly stronger.

As long as they were in this world, the Prime Gods’ methods of escape would far surpass those of regular Ninth Stage Peak powerhouses.

Initially, Lin Yuan hadn’t expected his venture into the Ocean of Light would result in the death of so many Prime Gods at once.

Lin Yuan had planned to settle all True Gods, while the remaining Prime Gods were to be hunted down one by one.

The Prime Gods had indeed powerful escaping tactics, but if pressed hard, once Lin Yuan controlled more and more vast and deep Spatial Layers, these Prime Gods would still be like birds in a cage, still manageable.

What Lin Yuan hadn’t anticipated was the cooperation from the Prime God of Light, who had voluntarily sealed the Ocean of Light, turning the dwelling place of the gods into a complete prison, giving Lin Yuan the opportunity to directly eliminate sixteen Prime Gods.

Before Lin Yuan’s arrival, the strongest life in this world were the Prime Gods, and many of the machinations within the Ocean of Light were targeted at the Prime Gods.

The initial sealing of the Ocean of Light’s Spatial Layers was meant to briefly trap the other Prime Gods.

Unexpectedly, this now became the death warrant for all Prime Gods.

…..

In fact, under such circumstances, with Lin Yuan’s power fully unleashed, both True Gods and Prime Gods would have died within five breaths.

However, such a forceful unleashing of power was too terrifying, and Lin Yuan was worried about damaging the True Divine Nature and Prime Divine Nature within the gods.

The Divine Lattice was not indestructible; Lin Yuan could easily destroy the Demigod Lattice if he wished.

True Divine Nature might be vastly more robust than the Demigod Lattice, but it might not withstand a full blow from Lin Yuan, and as for the Prime Divine Nature? It might withstand it, or it might not.

But Lin Yuan didn’t want to gamble.

After all, each Divine Lattice, Prime Divine Nature, represented a shortcut for Lin Yuan, their value far greater than the True Gods and Prime Gods themselves.

So when he had acted just now, Lin Yuan had been extremely cautious, carefully regulating his strength to avoid affecting any Divine Lattice or Prime Divine Nature.

“The Prime Divine Nature of the God of Divination?”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, a luminescent white Divine Lattice slowly floated, belonging to the God of Divination among the twenty-four Prime Gods.

In the initial wave of crushing power, the God of Divination was the first Prime God to fall, not because the God of Divination had the weakest survival capabilities.

In fact, the God of Divination’s capability to survive ranked among the top three out of the twenty-four Prime Gods.

The easy death of the God of Divination was entirely due to the backlash from the Door to the Myriad Realms, with only a tenth of its strength remaining.

With the God of Divination’s nature, having suffered such a blow, it should have hidden within its Divine Kingdom and not come out.

But the opportunity related to a Supreme God was too tempting; even knowing its severely wounded state, the God of Divination still wanted to join in.

What if?

What if it fortuitously received the opportunity from a Supreme God?
